mapper.select: SELECT dd.device_id AS deviceId, dd.device_code AS deviceCode, d.device_name AS deviceName, dt.type_name AS deviceTypeName, dd.plot_id AS plotId, p.plot_name AS plotName, dd.temperature, dd.humidity, dd.soil_moisture AS soilMoisture, dd.soil_temp AS soilTemp, dd.ph, dd.light_intensity AS lightIntensity, dd.co2, dd.device_status AS deviceStatus, d.online_status AS onlineStatus, dd.report_time AS reportTime FROM agri_iot_device_data dd LEFT JOIN agri_iot_device d ON dd.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN agri_iot_device_type dt ON d.device_type_id = dt.id LEFT JOIN agri_iot_plot p ON dd.plot_id = p.id WHERE dd.device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY dd.report_time DESC LIMIT 1
